name: sage
description: Sage — AI skills framework ported to Hermes Agent. Single plugin ships 53 SKILL.md files (15 slash-commanded + 38 auto-loaded), 5 agent personas, 10 reference templates, plugin-internal hooks, and a sage CLI wrapper.

plugins.name: sage
plugins.description: Single Hermes plugin that bundles the full Sage ecosystem (UNDERSTAND → ENVISION → DELIVER → REFLECT pipeline). On Hermes, ships as ~/.hermes/plugins/sage/ with skills/ + agents/ + references/ + hooks/ + scripts/ subdirs.

author.name: Rei Stewart (adapted from xoai/sage claude-code plugin)
